🚩 Is Your Mover Trustworthy? 6 Red Flags to Watch For!
Moving scams in Mumbai are real — here's how to spot them before it's too late 👇
❌ Red Flag 1 — No physical office or verifiable address. Only a mobile number.
❌ Red Flag 2 — No written quote. Verbal-only pricing = surprise charges on move day.
❌ Red Flag 3 — Cash only, no UPI, no receipt. Zero paper trail.
❌ Red Flag 4 — No transit insurance offered or discussed.
❌ Red Flag 5 — Zero Google reviews, no website, no online presence.
❌ Red Flag 6 — Demands 100% payment before the move begins.
✅ Green flags to look for: Verified Google listing · Written itemised quote · Transit insurance · UPI accepted · Balance paid after delivery
🔍 Always ask: Share your Google Maps link? Written quote on letterhead? Insurance included? UPI accepted?
✅ Peacekeeper ticks all the green flags — verified, insured & trusted.
📞 Check our Google reviews — then call us!
📍 All of Mumbai covered

📋 Documents You Need for an Interstate Move in India — Complete Checklist!
Don't get caught out on paperwork. Here's everything to sort 👇
🚗 Vehicle & RTO — NOC from current state · Re-register in new state within 12 months
🪪 Address & ID — Update Aadhaar online · Voter ID transfer · DL address update
📊 GST & Business — Update GST registration · Inform CA · Update business registration
🏫 School TC — Apply 2 weeks early · Carry mark sheets · TC + Aadhaar needed for new school
🏠 Utilities — Electricity & gas NOC · Cancel broadband · Update all subscriptions
🏦 Banking — Update all banks, credit cards & PAN · Inform demat/mutual fund provider
📅 Timeline: 2 weeks before → school TC & utility NOCs. After move → bank & Aadhaar update. Within 1 month → Voter ID, DL & GST.
💡 Always carry original documents in a separate bag — never in the truck!
📞 We handle the move — ask us anything about interstate relocations!
📍 Mumbai → Pan India

🛋️ Furniture Mover vs Regular Mover — What's the Real Difference?
Not all movers are trained for heavy furniture. Here's what a specialist does that a regular mover can't 👇
❌ Regular mover:
→ No dismantling — items moved as-is

→ No transit insurance

→ Furniture dollies, straps, corner guards & ramps
→ Floor blankets & door frame padding placed first
→ Stretch wrap + furniture blankets on every piece
→ Full reassembly at new home
→ Transit insurance included

📦 3 PM — Direct each box to its correct room as it comes off the truck.

🏙️ Moving into a High-Rise Mumbai Building? Arrange These 7 Things First!
Most people forget these steps and face delays on move day 👇
📄 1 — Get the Society NOC in writing. Most CHS buildings require it before any move.
🛗 2 — Pre-book the service lift 24 hrs in advance. Slots fill up fast.
🚛 3 — Arrange truck parking at both buildings. Never assume it's available.
🚪 4 — Check the service entrance & staircase width — oversized furniture can get stuck.
👥 5 — Inform floor neighbors in advance. Avoids complaints & keeps access smooth.
🛡️ 6 — Confirm security requirements — some societies need ID proof from the crew.
📸 7 — Do a pre-move walkthrough & photograph the new flat before items arrive.
